title: Audit log for note changes
prompt: Compliance needs a record of who changed what. Use Inferlo's built-in audit log: add its model to the app's models in src/models.ts, and record an audit log entry after a note is updated (PATCH /notes/:id, action "notes.update") and after a note is deleted (DELETE /notes/:id, action "notes.delete"). Each entry must have the signed-in user, the model "notes", the note's id as the record id, and the changed fields with their old and new values.
